IDS_ENABLE_DEBUGGING_HELP.en:
BEGIN_H3Debugging FeaturesEND_H3
          BR
          You can enable the debugging features on your NickelOS device in order to install and test custom code on your device.  This will allow you to:BR
          BEGIN_LIST
            LIST_ITEMRemove rootfs verification so you can modify OS files
            LIST_ITEMEnable SSH access to the device using the standard test keys so you can use tools such as BEGIN_CODE'cros flash'END_CODE to access the device
            LIST_ITEMEnable booting from USB so you can install an OS image from a USB drive
            LIST_ITEMSet both the dev and the system root login password to a custom value so you can manually SSH into the device
          END_LIST
          BR
          Once enabled, most of the debugging features will remain enabled even after performing a powerwash or wiping the data on an enterprise managed device.  To fully disable all debugging features, reinstall NickelOS.
          BR
          BR
          For more information about the debugging features see:BR
          https://www.chromium.org/chromium-os/how-tos-and-troubleshooting/debugging-features
          BR
          BR
          BEGIN_BOLDNote:END_BOLD  The system will reboot during the process.
IDS_ENABLE_DEBUGGING_HELP.t:
BEGIN_H3OntfoutingkenmerkeEND_H3
          BR
      Jy kan die ontfoutingkenmerke op jou NickelOS-toestel aktiveer om gepasmaakte kode op jou toestel te installeer en te toets. Dit sal jou toelaat om:BR
          BEGIN_LIST
            LIST_ITEMRootfs-verifikasie te verwyder sodat jy bedryfstelsellêers kan wysig
            LIST_ITEMSSH-toegang tot die toestel met die standaardtoetssleutels te aktiveer sodat jy nutsgoed soos BEGIN_CODE"cros flash"END_CODEkan gebruik om toegang tot die toestel te kry
            LIST_ITEMSelflaai vanaf USB moontlik te maak sodat jy ’n bedryfstelselkopie van ’n USB-datastokkie af kan installeer
            LIST_ITEMSowel die ontwikkelaar- as die stelselkernaanmeldwagwoord op ’n gepasmaakte waarde te stel sodat jy SSH handmatig op die toestel kan gebruik
          END_LIST
          BR
          Wanneer dit geaktiveer is, sal die meeste van die ontfoutingkenmerke geaktiveer bly selfs nadat ’n Powerwash uitgevoer is of die data op ’n ondernemingbestuurde toestel uitgevee is. Om alle ontfoutingkenmerke heeltemal te deaktiveer, moet jy NickelOS herinstalleer.
          BR
          BR
          Vir meer inligting oor die ontfoutingkenmerke, sien:BR
          https://www.chromium.org/chromium-os/how-tos-and-troubleshooting/debugging-features
          BR
          BR
          BEGIN_BOLDLet wel:END_BOLD Die stelsel sal tydens die proses herselflaai.

IDS_NICKEL_LOCAL_ACCOUNT_ERROR_SIGN_IN.en: Could not set up the account: DETAIL
IDS_NICKEL_LOCAL_ACCOUNT_ERROR_SIGN_IN.t: Kon nie die rekening opstel nie: DETAIL

IDS_NICKEL_LOCAL_ACCOUNT_ERROR_TOO_LONG.en: Creating the account took too long. Try again.
IDS_NICKEL_LOCAL_ACCOUNT_ERROR_TOO_LONG.t: Dit het te lank geneem om die rekening te skep. Probeer weer.

IDS_NICKEL_LOCAL_ACCOUNT_ERROR_USERNAME.en: Usernames start with a lowercase letter and use only lowercase letters, digits, - and _ (up to 32).
IDS_NICKEL_LOCAL_ACCOUNT_ERROR_USERNAME.t: Gebruikername begin met ’n kleinletter en gebruik net kleinletters, syfers, - en _ (tot 32).

IDS_NICKEL_LOCAL_ACCOUNT_MISMATCH.t: Die wagwoorde stem nie ooreen nie

IDS_NICKEL_LOCAL_ACCOUNT_PICTURE_SUBTITL.en: It shows on the sign-in screen and in the system tray. To use a photo of your own, go to Settings later.
IDS_NICKEL_LOCAL_ACCOUNT_PICTURE_SUBTITL.t: Dit verskyn op die aanmeldskerm en in die stelselbalk. Gaan later na Instellings om jou eie foto te gebruik.

IDS_NICKEL_LOCAL_ACCOUNT_SUBTITLE.en: Your account and its files live on this device, encrypted with your password. Without a Google account there is no way to recover them if you forget it.
IDS_NICKEL_LOCAL_ACCOUNT_SUBTITLE.t: Jou rekening en sy lêers word op hierdie toestel gehou, geënkripteer met jou wagwoord. Sonder ’n Google-rekening is daar geen manier om hulle te herwin as jy dit vergeet nie.

IDS_NICKEL_LOCAL_ACCOUNT_USERNAME_ERROR.en: Start with a lowercase letter; use lowercase letters, digits, - and _ (up to 32)
IDS_NICKEL_LOCAL_ACCOUNT_USERNAME_ERROR.t: Begin met ’n kleinletter; gebruik kleinletters, syfers, - en _ (tot 32)

IDS_NICKEL_LOCATION_ACCESS_MESSAGE.en: APP_NAME wants to know where this device is, found from nearby Wi-Fi networks and its internet address. Your answer is remembered for this app.
IDS_NICKEL_LOCATION_ACCESS_MESSAGE.t: APP_NAME wil weet waar hierdie toestel is, soos bepaal uit nabygeleë wi-fi-netwerke en sy internetadres. Jou antwoord word vir hierdie app onthou.

IDS_NICKEL_LOCATION_ACCESS_TITLE.en: Allow APP_NAME to use your location?
IDS_NICKEL_LOCATION_ACCESS_TITLE.t: Laat APP_NAME toe om jou ligging te gebruik?

IDS_NICKEL_LOCATION_OFF_MESSAGE.en: APP_NAME wants to use your location. To let it, turn on location access in Privacy controls.
IDS_NICKEL_LOCATION_OFF_MESSAGE.t: APP_NAME wil jou ligging gebruik. Skakel liggingtoegang in Privaatheidkontroles aan om dit toe te laat.

IDS_NICKEL_REMOTE_CONTROL_MESSAGE.en: APP_NAME wants to control this device's keyboard and pointer. Allow it only if you trust whoever is connecting.
IDS_NICKEL_REMOTE_CONTROL_MESSAGE.t: APP_NAME wil hierdie toestel se sleutelbord en wyser beheer. Laat dit net toe as jy die persoon wat koppel, vertrou.

IDS_NICKEL_SEARCH_ENGINE_CHOICE_INFO_DIA.en: You chose Minimal when you set up NickelOS, so no search engine was picked for you. These search engines are popular in your region and are shown in random order.
IDS_NICKEL_SEARCH_ENGINE_CHOICE_INFO_DIA.t: Jy het “Minimaal” gekies toe jy NickelOS opgestel het, so geen soekenjin is vir jou gekies nie. Hierdie soekenjins is gewild in jou streek en word in ewekansige volgorde gewys.

IDS_NICKEL_SETUP_EITHER_WAY.en: Either way, you get Bazaar to find more apps, and apps to open your photos, videos, music and documents.
IDS_NICKEL_SETUP_EITHER_WAY.t: Hoe ook al, jy kry Bazaar om meer programme te vind, en programme om jou foto's, video's, musiek en dokumente oop te maak.

IDS_NICKEL_SETUP_FULL_DESCRIPTION.en: Everything ready to go, and private. DuckDuckGo searches the web from the browser and the launcher, uBlock Origin blocks ads and trackers in the browser, Proton's private apps (Mail, Calendar, Drive, Pass and more) are installed, and free, open-source apps come with it: LibreOffice, OBS Studio, GIMP, Kdenlive and more.
IDS_NICKEL_SETUP_FULL_DESCRIPTION.t: Alles gereed, en privaat. DuckDuckGo deursoek die web vanuit die blaaier en die lanseerder, uBlock Origin blokkeer advertensies en spoorsnyers in die blaaier, Proton se privaat programme (Mail, Calendar, Drive, Pass en meer) word geïnstalleer, en gratis oopbronprogramme is ingesluit: LibreOffice, OBS Studio, GIMP, Kdenlive en meer.

IDS_NICKEL_SETUP_MINIMAL_DESCRIPTION.en: Just the basics. The launcher searches only this computer, and nothing else is set up for you.
IDS_NICKEL_SETUP_MINIMAL_DESCRIPTION.t: Net die basiese. Die lanseerder soek net op hierdie rekenaar, en niks anders word vir jou opgestel nie.

IDS_NICKEL_SETUP_SUBTITLE.en: You can change all of this later in Settings.
IDS_NICKEL_SETUP_SUBTITLE.t: Jy kan dit alles later in Instellings verander.

IDS_NICKEL_SETUP_TITLE.en: How would you like to start?

IDS_OMNIBOX_PEDAL_MANAGE_CHROMEOS_ACCESS.en: Personalize your accessibility tools in NickelOS settings

IDS_OOBE_CHROMEVOX_HINT_ANNOUNCEMENT_TEX.en: Do you want to activate ChromeVox, the built-in screen reader for NickelOS? If so, press the space bar.
IDS_OOBE_CHROMEVOX_HINT_ANNOUNCEMENT_TEX.t: Wil jy ChromeVox, NickelOS se ingeboude skermleser, aktiveer? Indien wel, druk die spasiebalk.

IDS_OOBE_CHROMEVOX_HINT_ANNOUNCEMENT_TEX.en: Do you want to activate ChromeVox, the built-in screen reader for NickelOS? If so, press and hold both volume keys for five seconds.
IDS_OOBE_CHROMEVOX_HINT_ANNOUNCEMENT_TEX.t: Wil jy ChromeVox, NickelOS se ingeboude skermleser, aktiveer? Indien wel, druk en hou albei volumesleutels vyf sekondes lank.

IDS_OOBE_CHROMEVOX_HINT_TEXT.en: Do you want to activate ChromeVox, the built-in screen reader for NickelOS?
IDS_OOBE_CHROMEVOX_HINT_TEXT.t: Wil jy ChromeVox, NickelOS se ingeboude skermleser, aktiveer?

IDS_OS_INSTALL_SCREEN_INTRO_CONTENT_0.en: Before starting, make sure you have a backup of your data. Installing DEVICE_OS will overwrite the disk you choose.
IDS_OS_INSTALL_SCREEN_INTRO_CONTENT_0.t: Maak seker dat jy ’n rugsteun van jou data het voordat jy begin. As jy DEVICE_OS installeer, sal die skyf wat jy kies, oorskryf word.

IDS_OS_INSTALL_SCREEN_INTRO_FOOTER.en: DEVICE_OS is free software provided as is: it may not work on every computer, and its authors are not responsible for any data loss.
IDS_OS_INSTALL_SCREEN_INTRO_FOOTER.t: DEVICE_OS is vrye sagteware wat verskaf word soos dit is: dit sal dalk nie op elke rekenaar werk nie, en die outeurs daarvan is nie vir enige verlies aan data verantwoordelik nie.

IDS_OS_SETTINGS_SYNC_FEATURE_LABEL.en: Your apps and settings will sync across all NickelOS devices where you are signed in with your Google account. For browser sync options, go to LINK_BEGINChrome settingsLINK_END.
IDS_OS_SETTINGS_SYNC_FEATURE_LABEL.t: Jou programme en instellings sal gesinkroniseer word op alle NickelOS-toestelle waarop jy met jou Google-rekening aangemeld is. Gaan na LINK_BEGINChrome-instellingsLINK_END toe vir blaaiersinkroniseringopsies.

IDS_PERSONALIZATION_APP_AMBIENT_MODE_NIC.en: When your screen is idle, show your pictures, time, and media info
IDS_PERSONALIZATION_APP_AMBIENT_MODE_NIC.t: Wys jou prente, die tyd en media-inligting wanneer jou skerm onaktief is

IDS_PERSONALIZATION_APP_AMBIENT_MODE_NIC.en: The screen saver shows the pictures in your Pictures folder and the folders in it. Add at least 2.
IDS_PERSONALIZATION_APP_AMBIENT_MODE_NIC.t: Die sluimerskerm wys die prente in jou Prente-vouer en die vouers daarin. Voeg ten minste 2 by.
Prente wat saam met NickelOS kom

IDS_PERSONALIZATION_APP_AMBIENT_MODE_NIC.en: The screen saver shows NickelOS's wallpapers. Turn this on to show the pictures in My files > Pictures instead.
IDS_PERSONALIZATION_APP_AMBIENT_MODE_NIC.t: Die sluimerskerm wys NickelOS se muurpapiere. Skakel dit aan om eerder die prente in My lêers > Pictures te wys.

IDS_PERSONALIZATION_APP_AMBIENT_MODE_NIC.en: From Open-Meteo, for your approximate location, which beaconDB works out from your internet address
IDS_PERSONALIZATION_APP_AMBIENT_MODE_NIC.t: Van Open-Meteo, vir jou benaderde ligging, wat beaconDB uit jou IP-adres bepaal

IDS_PRINT_PREVIEW_PRINTER_SETUP_INFO_MES.en: Make sure your printer is turned on and connected to the same network as your NickelOS device or use a USB cable
IDS_PRINT_PREVIEW_PRINTER_SETUP_INFO_MES.t: Maak seker dat jou drukker aangeskakel is en aan dieselfde wi-fi-netwerk as jou NickelOS-toestel gekoppel is, of gebruik ’n USB-kabel

IDS_SETTINGS_ACCOUNT_BODY_CHROMEOS.en: When on, data is saved in your Google Account and can be used on all your devices. When off, data is saved only to this device. For NickelOS sync options, go to LINK_BEGINNickelOS settingsLINK_END.
IDS_SETTINGS_ACCOUNT_BODY_CHROMEOS.t: Wanneer dit aan is, word data in jou Google-rekening gestoor en kan dit op al jou toestelle gebruik word. Wanneer dit af is, word data net op hierdie toestel gestoor. Gaan na LINK_BEGINNickelOS-instellingsLINK_END vir NickelOS-sinkroniseringopsies.

IDS_SETTINGS_APPS_ARC_VM_SHARED_USB_DEVI.en: Give Android apps control over USB devices on this NickelOS device. Permission will be requested each time you plug in a USB device. Individual Android apps will ask for additional permissions.
IDS_SETTINGS_APPS_ARC_VM_SHARED_USB_DEVI.t: Gee Android-apps beheer oor USB-toestelle op hierdie NickelOS-toestel. Toestemming sal versoek word elke keer wanneer jy by ’n USB-toestel inprop. Individuele Android-programme sal vir bykomende toestemmings vra.

IDS_SETTINGS_END_OF_LIFE_INCENTIVE_NO_OF.en: Your device is no longer receiving security and software updates.
IDS_SETTINGS_END_OF_LIFE_INCENTIVE_NO_OF.t: Jou toestel ontvang nie meer sekuriteit- en sagtewareopdaterings nie.

IDS_SETTINGS_END_OF_LIFE_INCENTIVE_NO_OF.en: This device no longer gets updates
IDS_SETTINGS_END_OF_LIFE_INCENTIVE_NO_OF.t: Hierdie toestel kry nie meer opdaterings nie

IDS_SETTINGS_END_OF_LIFE_INCENTIVE_OFFER.en: Your device is no longer receiving security and software updates.
IDS_SETTINGS_END_OF_LIFE_INCENTIVE_OFFER.t: Jou toestel ontvang nie meer sekuriteit- en sagtewareopdaterings nie.

IDS_SETTINGS_END_OF_LIFE_INCENTIVE_OFFER.en: This device no longer gets updates
IDS_SETTINGS_END_OF_LIFE_INCENTIVE_OFFER.t: Hierdie toestel kry nie meer opdaterings nie

IDS_SETTINGS_GUEST_OS_SHARED_USB_DEVICES.en: Give Android apps control over USB devices on this NickelOS device
IDS_SETTINGS_GUEST_OS_SHARED_USB_DEVICES.t: Gee Android-apps beheer oor USB-toestelle op hierdie NickelOS-toestel

IDS_SETTINGS_NEARBY_SHARE_DATA_USAGE_MOB.en: This option applies to NickelOS devices with a data plan or mobile network dongle, or when tethering to a portable hotspot
IDS_SETTINGS_NEARBY_SHARE_DATA_USAGE_MOB.t: Hierdie opsie is van toepassing op NickelOS-toestelle met ’n dataplan of mobielenetwerkdongel, of wat aan ’n draagbare warmkol verbind is

IDS_SETTINGS_NICKEL_ACCOUNTS_ADD_PERSON_.en: You'll be signed out. On the sign-in screen, the new person chooses a name, a username and a password.
IDS_SETTINGS_NICKEL_ACCOUNTS_ADD_PERSON_.t: Jy sal afgemeld word. Op die aanmeldskerm kies die nuwe persoon ’n naam, ’n gebruikernaam en ’n wagwoord.

IDS_SETTINGS_NICKEL_ACCOUNTS_ADMIN_BODY.en: Administrators can install software for everyone, change the system and manage accounts.
IDS_SETTINGS_NICKEL_ACCOUNTS_ADMIN_BODY.t: Administrateurs kan sagteware vir almal installeer, die stelsel verander en rekeninge bestuur.

IDS_SETTINGS_NICKEL_ACCOUNTS_LAST_ADMIN.en: This device needs at least one administrator
IDS_SETTINGS_NICKEL_ACCOUNTS_LAST_ADMIN.t: Hierdie toestel het ten minste een administrateur nodig

IDS_SETTINGS_NICKEL_ACCOUNTS_NO_OTHER_PE.en: No one else has an account on this device.
IDS_SETTINGS_NICKEL_ACCOUNTS_NO_OTHER_PE.t: Niemand anders het ’n rekening op hierdie toestel nie.

IDS_SETTINGS_NICKEL_ACCOUNTS_OTHER_PEOPL.en: Everyone has their own account and files. Administrators can install software for everyone, change the system and manage accounts.
IDS_SETTINGS_NICKEL_ACCOUNTS_OTHER_PEOPL.t: Almal het hul eie rekening en lêers. Administrateurs kan sagteware vir almal installeer, die stelsel verander en rekeninge bestuur.

IDS_SETTINGS_NICKEL_ACCOUNTS_PASSWORDS_D.t: Die nuwe wagwoorde stem nie ooreen nie

IDS_SETTINGS_NICKEL_ACCOUNTS_REMOVE_BODY.en: Their account and all their files are deleted from this device. This can't be undone.
IDS_SETTINGS_NICKEL_ACCOUNTS_REMOVE_BODY.t: Hul rekening en al hul lêers word van hierdie toestel af uitgevee. Dit kan nie ontdoen word nie.

IDS_SETTINGS_NICKEL_ACCOUNTS_WRONG_PASSW.t: Daardie wagwoord is nie reg nie

IDS_SETTINGS_NICKEL_ANDROID_ADMIN_ONLY.en: Only an administrator of this device can change these.
IDS_SETTINGS_NICKEL_ANDROID_ADMIN_ONLY.t: Net ’n administrateur van hierdie toestel kan dit verander.

IDS_SETTINGS_NICKEL_ANDROID_ARM_DESCRIPT.en: For apps built only for the ARM processors phones use, many games among them. Proprietary software, downloaded when you turn it on.
IDS_SETTINGS_NICKEL_ANDROID_ARM_DESCRIPT.t: Vir programme wat net gebou is vir die ARM-verwerkers wat fone gebruik, onder meer baie speletjies. Eiendomsagteware wat afgelaai word wanneer jy dit aanskakel.

IDS_SETTINGS_NICKEL_ANDROID_ARM_DIALOG_B.en: Many Android apps, games especially, are built only for the ARM processors phones use. To run them on this computer, Android needs a translator. NickelOS doesn't make or include one: turning this on downloads TRANSLATOR from GitHub, the same copy the Waydroid community's waydroid_script installs.
IDS_SETTINGS_NICKEL_ANDROID_ARM_DIALOG_B.t: Baie Android-programme, veral speletjies, is net gebou vir die ARM-verwerkers wat fone gebruik. Om hulle op hierdie rekenaar te laat loop, het Android ’n vertaler nodig. NickelOS maak of bevat nie self een nie: as jy dit aanskakel, word TRANSLATOR van GitHub af afgelaai, dieselfde kopie wat die Waydroid-gemeenskap se waydroid_script installeer.

IDS_SETTINGS_NICKEL_ANDROID_ARM_DIALOG_B.en: It's proprietary software, under its owner's terms, and you're the one installing it. Some apps may run slowly or not at all. Android restarts to use it.
IDS_SETTINGS_NICKEL_ANDROID_ARM_DIALOG_B.t: Dit is eiendomsagteware, onderhewig aan die eienaar se bepalings, en jy is die een wat dit installeer. Sommige programme loop dalk stadig of glad nie. Android herbegin om dit te gebruik.

IDS_SETTINGS_NICKEL_ANDROID_ERROR_DOWNLO.en: The download didn't finish. Check your connection, then try again.
IDS_SETTINGS_NICKEL_ANDROID_ERROR_DOWNLO.t: Die aflaai is nie voltooi nie. Gaan jou verbinding na en probeer dan weer.

IDS_SETTINGS_NICKEL_ANDROID_REMOVE_DESCR.en: Deletes Android, your Android apps and their data
IDS_SETTINGS_NICKEL_ANDROID_REMOVE_DESCR.t: Vee Android, jou Android-programme en hul data uit

IDS_SETTINGS_NICKEL_ANDROID_REMOVE_DIALO.en: Android, your Android apps and their data are deleted from this device. Other people who use it keep their Android data, but can't open their Android apps until Android is set up again.
IDS_SETTINGS_NICKEL_ANDROID_REMOVE_DIALO.t: Android, jou Android-programme en hul data word van hierdie toestel af uitgevee. Ander mense wat dit gebruik, hou hul Android-data, maar kan nie hul Android-programme oopmaak voordat Android weer opgestel is nie.

IDS_SETTINGS_NICKEL_ANDROID_SET_UP_DESCR.en: Android apps open in their own windows, next to your other apps. Setting up downloads Android (LineageOS, from the Waydroid project): about 1 GB, and 2.5 GB on this device.
IDS_SETTINGS_NICKEL_ANDROID_SET_UP_DESCR.t: Android-programme maak in hul eie vensters oop, langs jou ander programme. Opstelling laai Android (LineageOS, van die Waydroid-projek) af: sowat 1 GB, en 2,5 GB op hierdie toestel.

IDS_SETTINGS_NICKEL_ANDROID_UNAVAILABLE.en: Android apps aren't available right now.
IDS_SETTINGS_NICKEL_ANDROID_UNAVAILABLE.t: Android-programme is nie nou beskikbaar nie.

IDS_SETTINGS_NICKEL_ANDROID_USES.en: Android uses SIZE on this device
IDS_SETTINGS_NICKEL_ANDROID_USES.t: Android gebruik SIZE op hierdie toestel

IDS_SETTINGS_NICKEL_CLOUD_DESCRIPTION.en: See Google Drive, OneDrive, Dropbox and other cloud storage in Files
IDS_SETTINGS_NICKEL_CLOUD_DESCRIPTION.t: Sien Google Drive, OneDrive, Dropbox en ander wolkberging in Lêers

IDS_SETTINGS_NICKEL_CLOUD_DRIVE_HELP.en: Google Drive needs your own client ID and secret from the Google Cloud console.
IDS_SETTINGS_NICKEL_CLOUD_DRIVE_HELP.t: Google Drive het jou eie kliënt-ID en -geheim van die Google Cloud-konsole nodig.

IDS_SETTINGS_NICKEL_CLOUD_FAILED.en: Couldn't connect. Check the details and try again.
IDS_SETTINGS_NICKEL_CLOUD_FAILED.t: Kon nie koppel nie. Gaan die besonderhede na en probeer weer.

IDS_SETTINGS_NICKEL_CLOUD_RCLONE.en: NickelOS uses rclone to show your cloud storage in Files, so your files are easy to reach. Choose a service to sign in to.
IDS_SETTINGS_NICKEL_CLOUD_RCLONE.t: NickelOS gebruik rclone om jou wolkberging in Lêers te wys, sodat jou lêers maklik bereikbaar is. Kies ’n diens om by aan te meld.

IDS_SETTINGS_NICKEL_CLOUD_REMOVE_BODY.en: Files stops showing this account. Your files stay in the cloud, and you can add the account again later.
IDS_SETTINGS_NICKEL_CLOUD_REMOVE_BODY.t: Lêers wys nie meer hierdie rekening nie. Jou lêers bly in die wolk, en jy kan die rekening later weer byvoeg.

IDS_SETTINGS_NICKEL_CLOUD_SIGNING_IN.en: Finish signing in on the page that opened in your browser.
IDS_SETTINGS_NICKEL_CLOUD_SIGNING_IN.t: Voltooi die aanmelding op die bladsy wat in jou blaaier oopgemaak het.

IDS_SETTINGS_NICKEL_CLOUD_SIGN_IN_NOTE.en: When you connect, the service's sign-in page opens in your browser.
IDS_SETTINGS_NICKEL_CLOUD_SIGN_IN_NOTE.t: Wanneer jy koppel, maak die diens se aanmeldbladsy in jou blaaier oop.

IDS_SETTINGS_NICKEL_COMPUTER_NAME_ADMIN_.en: Only an administrator of this computer can change its name.
IDS_SETTINGS_NICKEL_COMPUTER_NAME_ADMIN_.t: Net ’n administrateur van hierdie rekenaar kan sy naam verander.

IDS_SETTINGS_NICKEL_COMPUTER_NAME_DIALOG.en: Other devices see this name on your network and over Bluetooth, and the Terminal and Linux apps show it.
IDS_SETTINGS_NICKEL_COMPUTER_NAME_DIALOG.t: Ander toestelle sien hierdie naam op jou netwerk en oor Bluetooth, en die Terminaal en Linux-programme wys dit.

IDS_SETTINGS_NICKEL_COMPUTER_NAME_FAILED.en: The name couldn't be changed. Try again.
IDS_SETTINGS_NICKEL_COMPUTER_NAME_FAILED.t: Die naam kon nie verander word nie. Probeer weer.

IDS_SETTINGS_NICKEL_COMPUTER_NAME_INVALI.en: Use at least one letter from A to Z or a number.
IDS_SETTINGS_NICKEL_COMPUTER_NAME_INVALI.t: Gebruik ten minste een letter van A tot Z of ’n syfer.

IDS_SETTINGS_NICKEL_DEFAULT_APPS_DESCRIP.en: The apps that open each kind of file, from Files and from Linux apps
IDS_SETTINGS_NICKEL_DEFAULT_APPS_DESCRIP.t: Die programme wat elke soort lêer oopmaak, vanuit Lêers en vanuit Linux-programme

IDS_SETTINGS_NICKEL_DEFAULT_APPS_NONE.t: Geen app maak dit oop nie

IDS_SETTINGS_NICKEL_DRIVES_DESCRIPTION.en: Drives inside this device besides the one with NickelOS. The drive that holds Windows opens read-only, so Windows stays intact.
IDS_SETTINGS_NICKEL_DRIVES_DESCRIPTION.t: Skywe in hierdie toestel buiten die een met NickelOS. Die skyf met Windows word leesalleen oopgemaak, sodat Windows ongeskonde bly.

IDS_SETTINGS_NICKEL_DRIVE_ALLOW_CHANGES_.en: Windows is on this drive. It's read-only unless you allow changes.
IDS_SETTINGS_NICKEL_DRIVE_ALLOW_CHANGES_.t: Windows is op hierdie skyf. Dit is leesalleen tensy jy veranderinge toelaat.

IDS_SETTINGS_NICKEL_DRIVE_DIALOG_BODY.en: With Fast Startup, Windows doesn't fully shut down, and changes made here can be lost or damage files when Windows starts again. Turn off Fast Startup in Windows, or hold Shift while you shut Windows down, before you make changes.
IDS_SETTINGS_NICKEL_DRIVE_DIALOG_BODY.t: Met Fast Startup sit Windows nie heeltemal af nie, en veranderinge wat jy hier maak, kan verlore gaan of lêers beskadig wanneer Windows weer begin. Skakel Fast Startup in Windows af, of hou Shift in terwyl jy Windows afsit, voordat jy veranderinge maak.

IDS_SETTINGS_NICKEL_DRIVE_DIALOG_TITLE.en: Allow changes to the Windows drive?
IDS_SETTINGS_NICKEL_DRIVE_DIALOG_TITLE.t: Laat veranderinge aan die Windows-skyf toe?

IDS_SETTINGS_NICKEL_DRIVE_HIBERNATED.en: Windows didn't shut down fully, so the drive stays read-only. Shut down Windows fully to make changes.
IDS_SETTINGS_NICKEL_DRIVE_HIBERNATED.t: Windows is nie heeltemal afgesit nie, dus bly die skyf leesalleen. Sit Windows heeltemal af om veranderinge te maak.

IDS_SETTINGS_NICKEL_HELP_COMMUNITY_DESCR.en: The forum, Discord and GitHub, on nickelos.dev
IDS_SETTINGS_NICKEL_HELP_COMMUNITY_DESCR.t: Die forum, Discord en GitHub, op nickelos.dev

IDS_SETTINGS_NICKEL_HELP_GENTOO_DESCRIPT.en: Portage and emerge from the start, with pacman and apt commands side by side
IDS_SETTINGS_NICKEL_HELP_GENTOO_DESCRIPT.t: Portage en emerge van die begin af, met pacman- en apt-opdragte langs mekaar

IDS_SETTINGS_NICKEL_HELP_GUIDE_DESCRIPTI.en: How NickelOS works. This copy came with your version of NickelOS and works offline.
IDS_SETTINGS_NICKEL_HELP_GUIDE_DESCRIPTI.t: Hoe NickelOS werk. Hierdie kopie het saam met jou weergawe van NickelOS gekom en werk vanlyn.

IDS_SETTINGS_NICKEL_HELP_TROUBLESHOOTING.en: Logs, crash reports, and the usual problems and their fixes
IDS_SETTINGS_NICKEL_HELP_TROUBLESHOOTING.t: Logboeke, omvalverslae, en die gewone probleme en hul oplossings

IDS_SETTINGS_NICKEL_PHONES_DESCRIPTION.en: With the KDE Connect app on Android or iPhone, on the same Wi‑Fi network
IDS_SETTINGS_NICKEL_PHONES_DESCRIPTION.t: Met die KDE Connect-app op Android of iPhone, op dieselfde wi‑fi-netwerk

IDS_SETTINGS_NICKEL_PHONES_NONE.en: No phones or tablets yet. Install KDE Connect from Google Play, F‑Droid or the App Store, open it on the same Wi‑Fi network, then pair from either device.
IDS_SETTINGS_NICKEL_PHONES_NONE.t: Nog geen fone of tablette nie. Installeer KDE Connect van Google Play, F‑Droid of die App Store af, maak dit op dieselfde wi‑fi-netwerk oop, en bind dan van enige van die twee toestelle af saam.

IDS_SETTINGS_NICKEL_PHONES_NOT_RUNNING.en: The phone connection isn't running. Sign out and back in to start it.
IDS_SETTINGS_NICKEL_PHONES_NOT_RUNNING.t: Die foonverbinding loop nie. Meld af en weer aan om dit te begin.

IDS_SETTINGS_NICKEL_PHONES_WANTS_TO_PAIR.en: Wants to pair with this device

IDS_SETTINGS_NICKEL_X11_KEYS_DESCRIPTION.en: Lets apps such as Discord use push-to-talk while you're in other windows. They see keys pressed with Ctrl, Alt or Search and function keys, never what you type.
IDS_SETTINGS_NICKEL_X11_KEYS_DESCRIPTION.t: Laat programme soos Discord druk-om-te-praat gebruik terwyl jy in ander vensters is. Hulle sien sleutels wat saam met Ctrl, Alt of Soek gedruk word, en funksiesleutels, maar nooit wat jy tik nie.

IDS_SETTINGS_NICKEL_X11_KEYS_LABEL.en: Shortcut keys for older Linux apps

IDS_SETTINGS_PRINTING_CUPS_HELP_SECTION_.en: Make sure your printer is connected to the same Wi-Fi network as your NickelOS device or use a USB cable. LINK_BEGINLearn more about compatibilityLINK_END
IDS_SETTINGS_PRINTING_CUPS_HELP_SECTION_.t: Maak seker dat jou drukker aan dieselfde wi-fi-netwerk as jou NickelOS-toestel gekoppel is, of gebruik ’n USB-kabel. LINK_BEGINKom meer te wete oor versoenbaarheidLINK_END

IDS_SETTINGS_PRINTING_CUPS_PRINTER_ADDED.en: Can’t connect to printer. Check that the printer is turned on and is connected to your NickelOS device by Wi-Fi or USB.
IDS_SETTINGS_PRINTING_CUPS_PRINTER_ADDED.t: Kan nie aan drukker koppel nie. Maak seker dat die drukker aangeskakel is en met Wi-Fi of USB aan jou NickelOS-toestel gekoppel is.

IDS_SETTINGS_SECURE_DNS_OPEN_CHROME_OS_S.en: Manage secure DNS in NickelOS settings

IDS_SETTINGS_SWITCH_ACCESS_SETUP_INTRO_B.en: To get started, please make sure your USB or Bluetooth switch is connected to your NickelOS device. You can also use keyboard keys.
IDS_SETTINGS_SWITCH_ACCESS_SETUP_INTRO_B.t: Om te begin, moet jy asseblief seker maak dat jou USB- of Bluetooth-skakelaar aan jou NickelOS-toestel gekoppel is. Jy kan ook sleutelbordsleutels gebruik.

IDS_SMART_LOCK_LABEL_LOOKING_FOR_PHONE.en: To unlock your NickelOS device, make sure your phone's Bluetooth is on
IDS_SMART_LOCK_LABEL_LOOKING_FOR_PHONE.t: Maak seker jou foon se Bluetooth is aan as jy jou NickelOS-toestel wil ontsluit

IDS_SMART_LOCK_LABEL_NO_BLUETOOTH.en: Your NickelOS device’s Bluetooth is off. To unlock your NickelOS device, enter password.
IDS_SMART_LOCK_LABEL_NO_BLUETOOTH.t: Jou NickelOS-toestel se Bluetooth is af. Voer wagwoord in om jou NickelOS-toestel te ontsluit.

IDS_SMART_LOCK_LABEL_NO_PHONE_LOCK_SCREE.en: Your phone doesn’t have a lock screen. To unlock your NickelOS device, enter password.
IDS_SMART_LOCK_LABEL_NO_PHONE_LOCK_SCREE.t: Jou foon het nie ’n sluitskerm nie. Voer wagwoord in om jou NickelOS-toestel te ontsluit.

IDS_SMART_LOCK_LABEL_PHONE_LOCKED.en: To unlock your NickelOS device, first unlock your phone
IDS_SMART_LOCK_LABEL_PHONE_LOCKED.t: Ontsluit eers jou foon as jy jou NickelOS-toestel wil ontsluit

IDS_SMART_PRIVACY_PROTECTION_CONTENT.en: Your device uses a built-in sensor to detect people in front of it. All data is processed on your device immediately and then deleted. Sensor data is never sent to Google.
IDS_SMART_PRIVACY_PROTECTION_CONTENT.t: Jou toestel gebruik ’n ingeboude sensor om mense voor dit te bespeur. Alle data word onmiddellik op jou toestel verwerk en dan uitgevee. Sensordata word nooit na Google toe gestuur nie.

IDS_SYNC_OTHER_SIGN_IN_ERROR_BUBBLE_VIEW.en: NickelOS could not sync your data due to an error signing in.
IDS_SYNC_OTHER_SIGN_IN_ERROR_BUBBLE_VIEW.t: NickelOS kon weens ’n fout met aanmelding nie jou data sinkroniseer nie.

IDS_SYNC_SIGN_IN_ERROR_BUBBLE_VIEW_MESSA.en: NickelOS could not sync your data because your account sign-in details are out of date.
IDS_SYNC_SIGN_IN_ERROR_BUBBLE_VIEW_MESSA.t: NickelOS kon nie jou data sinkroniseer nie omdat jou rekening se aanmeldbesonderhede verouderd is.

IDS_SYNC_UNAVAILABLE_ERROR_BUBBLE_VIEW_M.en: NickelOS could not sync your data because Sync is not available for your domain.
IDS_SYNC_UNAVAILABLE_ERROR_BUBBLE_VIEW_M.t: NickelOS kon nie jou data sinkroniseer nie omdat sinkronisering nie vir jou domein beskikbaar is nie.

IDS_TERMS_OF_SERVICE_SCREEN_SUBHEADING.en: MANAGER requires that you read and accept the following Terms of Service before using this device. These terms do not expand, modify or limit the NickelOS Terms.
IDS_TERMS_OF_SERVICE_SCREEN_SUBHEADING.t: MANAGER vereis dat jy die volgende diensbepalings lees en aanvaar voordat jy hierdie toestel gebruik. Hierdie bepalings verander, beperk of brei nie NickelOS se bepalings uit nie.

IDS_UPDATE_RECOMMENDED.en: NickelOS needs to be restarted to apply the update.
IDS_UPDATE_RECOMMENDED.t: NickelOS moet herbegin word om die opdatering toe te pas.

IDS_UPDATE_SLIDE_ACCOUNT_TEXT.en: You’ll sign in to your device with your own account, and everyone who uses it can have one.
IDS_UPDATE_SLIDE_ACCOUNT_TEXT.t: Jy sal met jou eie rekening by jou toestel aanmeld, en almal wat dit gebruik, kan een hê.

IDS_UPDATE_SLIDE_ACCOUNT_TITLE.en: Your own account on your device
IDS_UPDATE_SLIDE_ACCOUNT_TITLE.t: Jou eie rekening op jou toestel

IDS_UPDATE_SLIDE_ANTIVIRUS_TEXT.en: NickelOS is designed with security in mind, and it keeps itself up to date automatically.
IDS_UPDATE_SLIDE_ANTIVIRUS_TEXT.t: NickelOS is met sekuriteit in gedagte ontwerp, en hou homself outomaties op datum.

IDS_UPDATE_SLIDE_APPS_TEXT.en: NickelOS runs web apps and Linux apps side by side. Get apps for productivity, entertainment, and more.
IDS_UPDATE_SLIDE_APPS_TEXT.t: NickelOS laat webprogramme en Linux-programme langs mekaar loop. Kry programme vir produktiwiteit, vermaak en meer.

IDS_USER_INSTALLED_CHROME_APP_DEPRECATIO.en: Chrome apps don’t run on NickelOS. Consider an alternative app.
IDS_USER_INSTALLED_CHROME_APP_DEPRECATIO.t: Chrome-apps loop nie op NickelOS nie. Oorweeg ’n alternatiewe app.

IDS_WRONG_HWID_SCREEN_MESSAGE_FIRST_PART.en: Unfortunately, your computer is configured with a malformed hardware ID. This prevents NickelOS from updating with the latest security fixes and your computer BEGIN_BOLDmay be vulnerable to malicious attacksEND_BOLD.
IDS_WRONG_HWID_SCREEN_MESSAGE_FIRST_PART.t: Ongelukkig is jou rekenaar opgestel met ’n misvormde hardeware-ID. Dit verhinder NickelOS om met die nuutste sekuriteitsoplossings op te dateer, en jou rekenaar BEGIN_BOLDsal dalk blootgestel wees aan kwaadwillige aanvalleEND_BOLD.
